subject: Pau Cubarsí wins the 2026 Golden Boy
title: The defender who won the Golden Boy

lines.vo: Defenders almost never win the Golden Boy. One just did.
lines.footage: Cubarsí award moment, stage or press shot

lines.vo: Pau Cubarsí is nineteen, and he took the trophy from Désiré Doué. At nineteen, most people are still learning to do laundry.
He is the first defender to win it since Matthijs de Ligt in twenty-eighteen. Eight years of scouts only watching the goals.
Barcelona now have four winners in six years: Pedri, Gavi, Yamal and him. Other clubs have academies. Barcelona have a factory.
lines.footage: Pedri, Gavi and Yamal goal clips

lines.vo: He also won LaLiga and the World Cup with Spain this year. Then he came twelfth in the Ballon d'Or, as the top defender. Defenders usually get a handshake. Cubarsí got a trophy.

inserts.story: A cartoon trophy shaped like a striker looks surprised as a teenage defender receives it. Gag: the trophy tries to climb away and the defender holds it tight. Twist: the trophy gives up and sits on his shoulder.
inserts.characters: generic cartoon teen defender and trophy

inserts.story: A conveyor belt delivers four trophies to a shelf one by one. Gag: each trophy wears a different tiny shirt. Twist: the fifth trophy arrives and the shelf says Full.

facts_used: Cubarsí, 19, won the Golden Boy for best under-21 men's player, succeeding PSG's Désiré Doué (ev0112)
First defender to win since Matthijs de Ligt in 2018 (ev0112)
Fourth Barcelona winner in six years after Pedri, Gavi and Yamal (ev0112)
Won LaLiga and the World Cup with Spain in 2026; Young Player of the Tournament; 12th in Ballon d'Or as top defender (ev0112)
notes: Non-comic, light jokes only (age, scouts, factory, handshake callback). Tuttosport vote (100 nominees, 22 countries) not used. Spain-Argentina final detail not used. Laundry gag is generic, not a claim about the player.
